correctness.rationale: For n>=3 under the distinct-third-edge conflict definition, the only positive-site constraints are a pendant choice forcing site i+1 empty and a cycle choice forcing site i+2 empty. The two Boolean flags before each site have unique cyclic reconstruction; summing four mask weights gives the displayed 4x4 W, and closed length-n trajectories biject to labeled packings. Its exact characteristic polynomial gives the quartic recurrence with formal n=0,1,2 traces. Nonnegative leading terms and the n modulo 4 induction give degree floor(3n/4) and the four exact leading-coefficient formulas. I independently enumerated conflicting-edge subsets directly (not via the local rule) for n=3..8 and compared all coefficients, with leading terms also checked through n=19. This finite corroboration is separate from the unrestricted proof.
